cues: Three finger-operated valves redirect airflow through coiled tubing, allowing quick pitch changes during a band rehearsal.
A compact brass body ends in a widening bell that projects melody along a crowded parade route.
The mouthpiece cups the lips while a narrow leadpipe carries breath toward the instrument’s valves.
Bright, piercing tones can cut through chatter when a school ensemble gathers in the gym.
A hand works the valves rapidly during a lively dance-band solo, shaping crisp changes in pitch.
A small mute placed inside the bell softens the sound for late-night practice at home.
Its compact build makes the instrument easy to carry between rehearsal rooms and neighborhood performances.
A polished finish catches stage lights as clear upper notes rise above the rhythm section.
